prompt:
Create one high-fidelity desktop web application screenshot for an Advanced Databases product catalogue prototype. Landscape 1440x960, no browser chrome. This is a real CRUD working interface, not a poster, concept art, collage, or promotional site. No photos, no logos, no made-up claims, no invented IDs, dates, totals, metrics, rows, category names, or fields.

Visual direction: “Document Workbench”, grounded in database inspection workbenches. A student edits product records while an instructor reads the MongoDB document shape. Use a compact deep graphite-blue work surface #111820 with lifted dark panes #202A35, bright readable text #F3F6F8, and restrained mint-cyan #62D9C4 only for the active selection and primary action. Modern system sans for labels; precise monospaced type for JSON and all numeric data. No glow, no decorative neon, no gradient.

Composition: thin workbench toolbar with “Product catalogue”, a small “Sample data” marker, and “Add product”. Two dense, aligned panes: left product index (about 43% width), right document workspace (about 57%). The left pane has labeled search and category filter and exactly these four rows:
Samsung Galaxy A15 | Phones | ZMW 2,800 | Stock 14 | In stock
Tecno Spark 20 | Phones | ZMW 2,100 | Stock 22 | In stock
iPhone 13 | Phones | ZMW 11,500 | Stock 4 | Low stock
Cotton T-Shirt | Clothing | ZMW 150 | Stock 60 | In stock
Select Samsung Galaxy A15. Do not show extra rows, IDs or totals.

At right, show a clear “Edit product” form for Samsung Galaxy A15 with labeled Name, Category, Price (ZMW), Stock, Tags, Specs, with the exact values: Phones, 2800, 14, tags android and budget, specs storage 128GB, ram 4GB, battery 5000mAh. Show Save product, Cancel and Delete actions. Directly below, show “MongoDB document” with a read-only nested JSON view containing only name, category, price, stock, tags and specs with those exact values, no _id and no timestamps. The UI should feel like a focused tool for inspecting real document structure, not a generic admin dashboard. Clear hierarchy, code-like alignment, visible keyboard focus affordance, crisp readable text, no nested cards.
